mapper.sql: select u.user_id, u.dept_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.email, u.avatar, u.phonenumber, u.id_card, u.id_card_front, u.id_card_back, u.real_name, u.phone_verified, u.id_card_verified, u.face_verified, u.audit_status, u.audit_remark, u.audit_time, u.audit_by, u.verify_time, u.password, u.sex, u.status, u.del_flag, u.login_ip, u.login_date, u.pwd_update_date, u.create_by, u.create_time, u.update_by, u.update_time, u.remark, d.dept_id, d.parent_id, d.ancestors, d.dept_name, d.order_num, d.leader, d.status as dept_status, r.role_id, r.role_name, r.role_key, r.role_sort, r.data_scope, r.status as role_status from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id left join sys_user_role ur on u.user_id = ur.user_id left join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id
mapper.select:
select distinct u.user_id, u.dept_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.email, u.phonenumber, u.status, u.create_time from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id left join sys_user_role ur on u.user_id = ur.user_id left join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id where u.del_flag = '0' and (r.role_id != #{roleId} or r.role_id IS NULL) and u.user_id not in (select u.user_id from sys_user u inner join sys_user_role ur on u.user_id = ur.user_id and ur.role_id = #{roleId})
AND u.user_name like concat('%', #{userName}, '%')
AND u.phonenumber like concat('%', #{phonenumber}, '%')
${params.dataScope}
select user_id, user_name from sys_user where user_name = #{userName} and del_flag = '0' limit 1
select user_id, phonenumber from sys_user where phonenumber = #{phonenumber} and del_flag = '0' limit 1
select user_id, email from sys_user where email = #{email} and del_flag = '0' limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into sys_user( user_id, dept_id, user_name, nick_name, email, avatar, phonenumber, id_card, id_card_front, id_card_back, real_name, phone_verified, id_card_verified, face_verified, audit_status, audit_remark, verify_time, sex, password, status, pwd_update_date, create_by, remark, create_time )values( #{userId}, #{deptId}, #{userName}, #{nickName}, #{email}, #{avatar}, #{phonenumber}, #{idCard}, #{idCardFront}, #{idCardBack}, #{realName}, #{phoneVerified}, #{idCardVerified}, #{faceVerified}, #{auditStatus}, #{auditRemark}, #{verifyTime}, #{sex}, #{password}, #{status}, #{pwdUpdateDate}, #{createBy}, #{remark}, sysdate() )
mapper.update: update sys_user set status = #{status}, update_time = sysdate() where user_id = #{userId}
update sys_user set avatar = #{avatar}, update_time = sysdate() where user_id = #{userId}
update sys_user set login_ip = #{loginIp}, login_date = #{loginDate} where user_id = #{userId}
update sys_user set pwd_update_date = sysdate(), password = #{password}, update_time = sysdate() where user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: update sys_user set del_flag = '2' where user_id = #{userId}
